target.consumer: fresh /wc workers, /g successors and verification/control projections

problem: The canonical and public /wc bootstrap declares Universal Cognitive Worker Canary v3.1, while durable coordination state still records or describes /wc v3.0 in CONTINUITY_HEAD.json and FOCUS.json. Fresh workers that correctly load /wc can therefore disagree with successors or projections that trust durable control-plane metadata, weakening auditability and making version claims dependent on which authority path was read last.
acceptance: One canonical machine-readable worker-canary version authority is identified or introduced without changing production /w authority.
CONTINUITY_HEAD.json and FOCUS.json either derive from that authority or contain the same current /wc version as the canonical bootstrap.
An automated coherence check fails when canonical /wc, durable version metadata or any declared public-canary version diverge.
The check distinguishes canary /wc from production /w and cannot promote Current, Human Accepted or Served state.
Existing worker behavior, queue authority and preserve-first constraints remain unchanged apart from the version-coherence repair.
title: Guard /wc version coherence
mission: Eliminate worker-canary version drift by making the canonical /wc version and durable control-plane references converge through one explicit authority path plus a regression test, without treating the repair as production /w promotion.

goal_relevance.reason: Fresh identical /wc chats are the active high-parallelism canary; inconsistent version metadata directly weakens reproducible worker recovery and coordination.

information_gain.reason: A coherence guard turns an implicit contradiction into a deterministic failing signal rather than allowing successors to choose whichever version label they encountered.

human_friction_reduction.reason: The human should not need to notice or explain that the public worker was upgraded while durable state remained stale.

regression_prevention.reason: A version-coherence test prevents future bootstrap upgrades from silently leaving Continuity Head or FOCUS behind.

falsification: Canonical /wc reports a version different from durable Continuity Head or FOCUS and the validator still passes.
The repair makes any claim that production /w is operational, Current, Human Accepted or Served.
The repair requires the human to manually synchronize version labels after a future /wc upgrade.
A worker can pass the coherence check without reading the canonical version authority.
dedup_note: The inspected active queue and claims already cover the worker kernel, allocator, readiness, recovery, control room, critics and all four surface lenses. Repository search returned no existing proposal keyed to worker_canary_version/v3.1/FOCUS version coherence. This proposal is deliberately narrower than worker-kernel or control-room work: it addresses only authoritative canary-version drift and its regression guard.
